title: Apple Launches Study on Conversational AI Health Tools
excerpt: Apple has announced a new study to examine how users interact with conversational AI health tools and evaluate their usefulness.
body_html:
Apple has announced the launch of a new research initiative called the Apple Health AI Usage Study. The primary goal of the project is to better understand how individuals interact with conversational artificial intelligence tools designed for health purposes, as well as to evaluate the practical usefulness of the responses they provide.

For this initiative, Apple is collaborating with OpenEvidence, which is a clinical artificial intelligence platform utilized by healthcare professionals to generate answers based on medical information.

The study aims to gather insights into the effectiveness of these digital tools in a health context as conversational AI continues to see development and integration into everyday technology.
